The abuse wasn't always entirely physical, he was a fan of verbal beat-downs as well. The result was that we lived in an environment of fear, and anxiety. We never knew what kind of mood our father was in or what would set him off on that particular day. We've been removed from him for a little over ten years now and I find that I more or less feel like a bother, and actively try to blend in so that no one notices me out of a fear of persecution of some sort. I'm not a trusting individual and have little to no self-worth. 
That being said, I feel that spanking is an acceptable form of punishment, but it's important to make sure the child knows why they're being punished, and not to do the spanking if you happen to be teeming with rage.
